interpretation.primary: The editor ran out of memory on a single 1 GiB allocation from the shader compiling thread, AFTER shader compilation reported 0 shaders remaining.
interpretation.secondary: 3560 open file handles and 616 packages still uncooked indicate the cook was resource-bound, not hung. It was making progress and then died on allocation failure.
not_caused_by: Not an external kill: the log contains an explicit in-process fatal error, not a control-event exit code.
Not the Import.py SyntaxWarning: this process is UE4Editor.exe, not the Python importer.
Not disk exhaustion: G: retains 41.75 GB free and E: was remediated to 26.09 GB free.
interpretation.caveat: The exact allocation site in ShaderCompiler.cpp:1236 was NOT inspected, so the precise cause (fragmentation vs. a single oversized buffer vs. commit-charge exhaustion) is not established. Machine has 48 GB RAM; commit exhaustion under a 3560-handle workload is plausible but unproven.
